title: Audit Of Privileged Access Semantic Contract
description: Source-backed draft semantic contract for the audit of privileged access capability, derived from historical React evidence as lineage. Facets cite verified source-import manifest rows; proof is hermetic/runtime lineage and not fresh USF proof.
aiGuidance: Source-backed draft. Facets cite verified manifest source rows as lineage; proof is hermetic/stale and not current readiness. Do not treat as implementation authority or fresh proof; respect the hexagonal constraint in ADR 0005.

lifecycle.description: Read-only contextual query: choose a logical resource, map to stored, check per-context permission, query tenant-scoped, redact secrets, bound results.

stateModel.description: Audit events carry action, actor, resource, id, timestamp, and redacted metadata; logical resources map to stored event kinds.

permissions.description: Coarse tenant.audit.read plus a per-context permission for members, config, features, or auth-settings.

contracts.description: Org-scoped audit query with resource/actor/action/time filters; tenant derives from the session, never the client.

validation.description: Unknown logical resources are invalid; missing per-context permission is forbidden; the result limit is clamped.

errorModel.description: ok, forbidden, and invalid outcomes with deterministic mapping.

auditModel.description: This capability reads existing audit events rather than mutating; secret metadata is redacted and request metadata is not exposed.

readinessModel.description: Invariant-ready; the read-only projection enforces isolation, secret exclusion, pagination, and no mutation.

proof.description: Unit proof of the read-only audit projection and the shared audit-event contract. Demonstrated in React via hermetic/runtime proof lineage; fresh USF proof pending USF-101/USF-59.

uiSemanticDefinition.description: Audit panels with logical-resource, action, actor, and time filters, pagination, forbidden/invalid states, and redacted metadata.
